en: The front side of the postcard shows a stone lighthouse or beacon structure at a breakwater, with several people, including adults and children, dressed in old-fashioned clothing. The structure is by the sea and has a large medallion or relief on its wall. The sky is clear and the water is calm. The text includes both Bulgarian Cyrillic (ВАРНА) and Latin script (VARNA), and the word 'Вълнолома' which means 'breakwater'. The reverse side has handwritten correspondence in Bulgarian, some French text ('Union Postale Universelle', 'Carte Postale'), postal markings, and several stamps and addresses, including one for Varna.
